name: harness-electron
description: Electron shell for the Harness Python engine (dev-mode only)

scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.main.json && tsc -p tsconfig.renderer.json && node scripts/copy-assets.mjs
scripts.dev: npx prettier . -w && npm run build && node scripts/launch.mjs
scripts.start: npx prettier . -w && npm run build && node scripts/launch.mjs
